problem_text:
A city planner must distribute a fixed budget across 18 public infrastructure projects to maximize the total expected community benefit.  
The characteristics of each project are as follows:  
* Project A: expected benefit is 0.095, disruption index is 0.121, allocation limits [0.005, 0.630]  
* Project B: expected benefit is 0.188, disruption index is 0.236, allocation limits [0.024, 0.733]  
* Project C: expected benefit is 0.111, disruption index is 0.126, allocation limits [0.004, 0.545]  
* Project D: expected benefit is 0.024, disruption index is 0.089, allocation limits [0.015, 0.667]  
* Project E: expected benefit is 0.128, disruption index is 0.063, allocation limits [0.088, 0.495]  
* Project F: expected benefit is 0.145, disruption index is 0.056, allocation limits [0.093, 0.334]  
* Project G: expected benefit is 0.043, disruption index is 0.073, allocation limits [0.027, 0.790]  
* Project H: expected benefit is 0.028, disruption index is 0.212, allocation limits [0.079, 0.794]  
* Project I: expected benefit is 0.122, disruption index is 0.265, allocation limits [0.064, 0.432]  
* Project J: expected benefit is 0.163, disruption index is 0.239, allocation limits [0.025, 0.879]  
* Project K: expected benefit is 0.145, disruption index is 0.142, allocation limits [0.082, 0.406]  
* Project L: expected benefit is 0.153, disruption index is 0.215, allocation limits [0.053, 0.883]  
* Project M: expected benefit is 0.092, disruption index is 0.162, allocation limits [0.000, 0.622]  
* Project N: expected benefit is 0.143, disruption index is 0.098, allocation limits [0.035, 0.887]  
* Project O: expected benefit is 0.177, disruption index is 0.074, allocation limits [0.061, 0.767]  
* Project P: expected benefit is 0.195, disruption index is 0.215, allocation limits [0.037, 0.768]  
* Project Q: expected benefit is 0.050, disruption index is 0.170, allocation limits [0.008, 0.364]  
* Project R: expected benefit is 0.155, disruption index is 0.060, allocation limits [0.071, 0.747]  

Each project must receive a budget share within its specified limits, and the total allocation across all projects must sum to one. To ensure equitable regional development, the group of high-visibility projects, represented by the subset H = {C, F, G, K, L, P}, must collectively receive at least 0.313 of the total budget. Additionally, the overall disruption index of the portfolio must not exceed 0.201, and the total expected benefit must be at least 0.092. Determine the optimal budget allocation that maximizes total expected benefit while satisfying all constraints.
